subject: general
question: Which of the following is a consumer right?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Seek Redressal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The process of defending the general public against unethical business activities is known as consumer protection.
 
• Laws frequently create requirements for consumer protection.
 
• These rules are designed to stop companies from using fraud or other specific unfair acts to obtain an edge over rivals or deceive customers.
 
• **Various consumer rights are:**
 
 
• **Right to Safety: **
 
 
• **​**This means the right to be protected against the marketing of goods and services, which are hazardous to life and property.
 
• The purchased goods and services availed of should not only meet their immediate needs but also fulfil long-term interests.
 
 
 
• **Right to be Informed:**
 
 
• **​ **This means the right to be informed about the quality, quantity, potency, purity, standard and price of goods so as to protect the consumer against unfair trade practices.
 
 
 
• **Right to Choose:**
 
 
• **​** This means the right to be assured, wherever possible of access to a variety of goods and services at a competitive price.
 
• In the case of monopolies, it means the right to be assured of satisfactory quality and service at a fair price.
 
• It also includes the right to basic goods and services.
 
 
 
• **Right to be Heard: **
 
 
• This means that consumers' interests will receive due consideration at appropriate forums.
 
• It also includes the right to be represented in various forums formed to consider the consumer's welfare.
 
 
 
• **Right to Seek redressal:**
 
 
• **​This means** the right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices or unscrupulous exploitation of consumers.
 
• It also includes the right to fair settlement of the genuine grievances of the consumer.
 
 
 
• **Right to Consumer Education:**
 
 
• **​​**Means the right to acquire the knowledge and skill to be an informed consumer throughout life
